purpose: Teach: 心底/まんが/諸々/愛想/すばやく/はまり/ゆで/まだしも

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店を心底気に入って下さってるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, our regular customers really do love this place, don't they?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft smile in the voice. Gentle cadence, lingering on the affection. No urgency.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、まんが雑誌を持ってこられたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you see? That customer brought in a manga magazine today.
lines.style: Noticing something small and genuine. Quiet wonder — the kind of attentiveness that catches details. Even pacing, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、諸々の打ち合わせは午後にしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's schedule the rest of our meetings for this afternoon, alright?
lines.style: Gentle directive. Clear but not commanding. The tone of someone offering a sensible plan, inviting agreement. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に愛想よく接するのは大事ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It really does matter how warmly you treat the customers, Aoi.
lines.style: Light teaching moment. Not lecturing — affirming something Aoi probably already knows. Warm underneath, with quiet confidence in her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人さん、すばやく動けるようになったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new staff member has really gotten quick on their feet, haven't they?
lines.style: Genuine appreciation. Open, unpretentious. A beat of real pleasure at growth. No condescension, just recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューにすっかりはまりこんでるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Our customers are really taken with that new menu item, aren't they?
lines.style: Pleased observation, almost marveling. Light, conversational tone. The satisfaction of watching something work. Slight rise at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ゆで野菜のサラダも追加しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should add a boiled vegetable salad to the menu too.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion. Calm, measured delivery. The tone of someone turning an idea over and deciding it's right. Practical but not rushed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、雨ならまだしも、台風だと閉店も考えるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Rain we can handle, but if a typhoon comes through, we might need to close for the day.
lines.style: Realistic concern delivered without alarm. Practical reasoning. Slight trailing weight on the last phrase — the kind of caution that shows care.
